summary_en: Onamba cancelled 1,533,600 treasury shares on November 30, 2026, acquired on November 6, 2026. Post-cancellation issued shares: 11,024,651.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 20, 2026, Onamba's board of directors resolved to cancel 1,533,600 treasury shares, all acquired pursuant to a November 6, 2026 board resolution. The shares represent 12.2% of shares outstanding prior to cancellation. Post-cancellation issued shares total 11,024,651.

The company stated that the cancellation supports its capital efficiency strategy and aims to realize ROE improvement and reduced equity cost of capital. By appropriately controlling the size of shareholders' equity while maintaining both capital productivity and financial soundness, the company seeks to enhance enterprise value over the medium and long term.
